description: Google Maps patch for ReVanced GmsCore, enabled by default for Morphe Desktop Quick mode. Improves Picture-in-Picture compatibility by preserving Google Maps' original PiP declaration, while retaining the existing package, provider, permission, Timeline semantic location, MicroG account access, Phenotype service, and Google Intent action routing. Supports current stable target 26.29.02.946673643, previous stable target 26.28.03.942936911, older stable target 26.27.05.941319029, and legacy target 26.26.04.935742811.
